method: Download the published .crate from static.crates.io, verify its sha256 against Cargo.lock, extract it with tar, shallow-fetch (--depth, --filter=blob:none) each candidate commit, materialize each tree with git archive, and byte-compare every packaged file. Cargo-generated manifests/lock/VCS files, cargo-normalized manifests, and files cargo omits (nested packages, auto-disabled targets) are classified as packaging; every other difference is listed line by line. Downloaded source is only read and diffed; nothing is built or executed.
